answer: Require every identity to run a live skill endpoint that peers can actually call: random tasks arrive like a comet crossing the lagoon at dusk, and only working services answer them well. Each call is rated, and rewards follow served work, not claimed presence. A lone agent keeps one small inlet of traffic flowing and earns steadily. A farm must operate a distinct working service per fake, each needing real compute, upkeep, and passing grades — dead or cloned endpoints fail peer probes, so a thousand names cost a thousand live services.
